data.name: iPhone 15 Pro
data.tagline: Titanium. So strong. So light. So Pro.
data.description: The iPhone 15 Pro is the first iPhone to feature an aerospace-grade titanium design, making it lighter and more durable than ever before. It is powered by the groundbreaking A17 Pro chip.

data.name: iPhone 15
data.description: The iPhone 15 features a stunning new design with color-infused back glass and a contoured aerospace-grade aluminum enclosure.

data.name: iPhone 15 Plus
data.description: The iPhone 15 Plus offers a huge Super Retina XDR display that brings your content to life with vibrant colors and incredible detail.

data.name: MacBook Pro 16"
data.description: The MacBook Pro 16-inch is the most advanced Mac laptop ever, powered by the M3 Max chip for extreme performance.

data.name: MacBook Air 15"
data.description: The MacBook Air 15-inch is impressively big on screen space yet impressively thin and light. Supercharged by the M2 chip.

data.name: MacBook Air 13"
data.description: The MacBook Air 13-inch is the world's best-selling laptop combining portability with the power of the M2 chip.

data.name: iMac
data.description: The iMac is the all-in-one for all, now supercharged by the M3 chip for even faster performance with a stunning 24-inch 4.5K Retina display.

data.name: iPad Pro 12.9"
data.description: The iPad Pro 12.9-inch provides the ultimate iPad experience, supercharged by the M2 chip for groundbreaking performance.

data.name: iPad Air
data.description: The iPad Air combines serious performance with a thin and light design. Powered by the breakthrough M1 chip.

data.name: iPad Mini
data.description: The iPad Mini delivers mega power in a mini size, offering the full iPad experience designed to fit in the palm of your hand.

data.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
data.description: The Apple Watch Ultra 2 is the most rugged and capable Apple Watch ever, designed for endurance athletes and adventurers.

data.name: Apple Watch Series 9
data.description: The Apple Watch Series 9 is smarter, brighter, and mightier, powered by the custom S9 SiP for a boost in performance.

data.name: AirPods Pro (2nd Gen)
data.description: The AirPods Pro feature the new H2 chip, delivering smarter noise cancellation and superior sound with Adaptive Audio.

data.name: AirPods Max
data.description: AirPods Max reimagine over-ear headphones with an Apple-designed dynamic driver that provides high-fidelity audio.

data.name: Apple Vision Pro
data.description: Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical world.
